limitations: The callback differential includes callback dispatch, loop/JIT differences and bookkeeping; it is not a pure transition measurement and must not be multiplied into exact shell attribution.

Memory batches use hot buffers and retained views/copies. Slice includes allocation and possible GC; set reuses a destination. View timing includes construction and two byte reads, not scanning all payload bytes.
Both WASM and ordinary ArrayBuffer cases execute in the same browser worker; these microbenchmarks are not Brush versus just-bash interpreter benchmarks.
Cost mode times all WASI imports and custom browser imports except phase events. Import spans begin after entry into JavaScript; transitions and profiler overhead remain unattributed.
Host spans include normalization, copies and backpressure. Their nested children must not be added again. Worker blocked time overlaps main-thread processing.
Phase mode records only command boundaries in the worker. Both modes retain identical bounded main-thread delivery/frame tracing. Instrumentation overhead is reported separately.

Terminal submit measures synchronous Ghostty write, including VT parsing and terminal-state work. Last-drain-to-frame includes scheduling/drawing and is not isolated GPU time or physical presentation.
Known-backlog gaps measure intervals between drains when bytes were already queued. They overlap other threads and may contain frame work; they are not extra CPU work.
The just-bash execution span includes interpreter, virtual filesystem and output-string construction. It is not pure interpreter CPU time.

Bashkit Terminal spans include its native editor, interpreter and vt100 screen parser. takeOutput timing includes Rust draining, wasm-bindgen copying and JS allocation; it is not a pure transition cost. WASI counters do not apply to this API.

Immediate presentation can draw during terminal.write. Terminal submit time then includes that synchronous drawing, and lastDrainToFrameMs can be negative because onFrame fires before write returns. Neither value measures physical display presentation.
